press_references.value: Vectra AI and Zscaler Expand Their Alliance to Unlock Unprecedented Visibility into SASE Traffic

partnership_announcements.description: Vectra AI and Zscaler have announced an expanded partnership, introducing a new technical integration that enhances visibility into SASE traffic and strengthens detection, response, and Zero Trust enforcement for enterprise customers. This collaboration extends their previous technical integration and aims to address market demand for comprehensive security in cloud-first and hybrid work environments.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Expands Partnership with CrowdStrike to Launch Offering for SMB and Midmarket Security Teams

partnership_announcements.description: Vectra AI and CrowdStrike have expanded their partnership to launch a new joint cybersecurity offering tailored for small and midsize businesses (SMBs) and midmarket organizations. The solution combines Vectra AI's network detection and response with CrowdStrike's endpoint protection, aiming to provide real-time detection and response across hybrid environments. The offering is designed for rapid deployment, transparent pricing, and ease of adoption, addressing the needs of smaller security teams and managed security service providers.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vectra AI is researching methods for managing security alerts by automatically isolating malicious activity using ensemble pattern recognition, as described in 'Method, product, and system for automatically isolating malicious security.' Their work also includes analyzing computer networks to identify attack paths and generate detection signatures, as detailed in titles such as 'Method, product, and system for analyzing a computer network to identify attack' and 'Method, product, and system for generating detection signatures.' These areas focus on AI-driven threat detection and response.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Delivers Unified Network Observability Across All Major Cloud Platforms to Stop Hybrid Threats Faster

product_launches.description: Vectra AI expanded its Vectra AI Platform with new multi-cloud network observability and threat detection capabilities across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, providing unified visibility and AI-assisted investigations for hybrid environments.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Advances Network Observability with Proactive Exposure Management Built for AI Enterprises

product_launches.description: Vectra AI launched new exposure management capabilities within the Vectra AI Platform, adding continuous asset inventory, proactive exposure detections, and environment observability to help AI-driven enterprises identify and reduce security gaps across hybrid and multi-cloud networks.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Launches Next-Generation Platform to Secure the AI Enterprise with Preemptive and Proactive Defense

product_launches.description: Vectra AI launched the next generation of its flagship cybersecurity platform, adding unified observability, AI agent discovery and hunting, and accelerated investigation features to provide preemptive and proactive defense for AI-driven enterprises.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Empowers Partners with Unified Microsoft Security Through New Vectra AI Shield Solution

product_launches.description: Vectra AI launched Vectra AI Shield for Microsoft, a new AI-powered security platform that unifies threat visibility and response across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Copilot for M365, and Azure Cloud for channel partners and MSSPs.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Analyst is Now available in the New AWS Marketplace AI Agents and Tools Category

product_launches.description: Vectra AI announced the launch of Vectra AI Analyst in the new AWS Marketplace AI Agents and Tools category, enabling customers to access advanced AI-driven incident response and threat detection capabilities through AWS.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Broadens its AI Agents to Bolster Cybersecurity for Customers

product_launches.description: Vectra AI has launched its new AI agent, Vectra AI Analyst, expanding its AI agent portfolio to provide enhanced cybersecurity tools for business customers. The new product aims to automate escalation workflows and investigative reporting, helping IT security teams respond more quickly to threats.

press_references.value: Vectra AI Completes Groundbreaking Agent Portfolio, Setting New Standard in Agentic AI for Enhanced Threat Detection and Security Team Efficiency

product_launches.description: Vectra AI launched its completed portfolio of AI agents, including the new AI Analyst, designed to enhance threat detection and security team efficiency.

overview_description.description: Vectra AI develops an AI-driven integrated attack signal for threat detection and response. It empowers hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises to see and stop advanced attacks before they become breaches. The company assists SOC analysts in turning the tables on attackers by applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to the problem of finding attack signals.
